title: He kept going for 29 years after it was over 🌴
caption:
The war ended in 1945. He didn't stop until 1974.
Would you have believed the leaflets? 👇
sources: Onoda H. (1974) 'No Surrender: My Thirty-Year War' (Kodansha; English 1999, Naval Institute Press)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Hiroo Onoda' (Lubang Island 1944-1974; surrendered after Major Yoshimi Taniguchi rescinded his orders, March 1974)
The New York Times obituary, 'Hiroo Onoda, Soldier Who Hid in Jungle for Decades, Dies at 91' (17 Jan 2014; Norio Suzuki found him; about 30 islanders killed)
